summary: Register a Storyteller rule for earned high-skill/Peak Play. SCK is a general strategic cognition component, not a Werewolf/Avalon component. Social-deduction games are only dense adversarial benchmarks. In the novel, strategic cognition may appear in peaceful cooperation, mixed-motive institutional games, research, work, family, negotiation, evaluation and long-term repeated interaction. Rare Peak Play may be rendered in detail when it is causally earned by prior information, experience, reputation, resources and rule/opponent understanding.
decisions: Do not equate SCK with Werewolf, Avalon or deception games; those are benchmark substrates only.
Allow Ordinary Play, Skilled Play, Peak Play and very rare Legendary Play in reader-facing prose.
Peak Play must be earned by lawful information, prior experience, rule understanding, opponent modelling, resources, reputation, preparation and risk capacity; no sudden omniscience.

When a high-skill Game deserves prose, preserve enough of observation -> interpretation -> probe -> response -> belief update -> positioning -> counterplay -> commitment -> execution -> payoff for the reader to reconstruct why the move worked.
Do not make opponents stupid to manufacture brilliance. Their counterplay must remain locally rational under their own information sets.
Successful deception or power play writes back trust, threat perception, reputation, access and future countermeasures; a brilliant chapter does not reset the world afterward.

Meta-game awareness may combine with Peak Play: an actor may infer the evaluator, hidden metric or rule-designer intent and strategically manage what is displayed, while Storyteller renders concrete clues rather than backend labels.
Most of the novel remains ordinary life. Rare high-skill sequences are valuable because they concentrate long-term accumulated state into a few decisive rounds.
